products.name: Grammarly for Education
products.note: Institutional writing support; student data; FERPA compliance; generative AI features

profile_text.body:
Grammarly is a for-profit company founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its core offering is an AI writing assistance tool that works across apps and websites, providing suggestions for grammar, tone, conciseness, and style. The company describes itself as making AI writing convenient through personalized guidance and text generation, and states that it does not sell or monetize user content, provide it for advertising purposes, or allow third-party service providers to train their models on it.

The company tracks two primary products: Grammarly, a general writing and editing assistant that reads document text broadly, and Grammarly for Education, an institutional product designed for student use with noted features around FERPA compliance and generative AI. Grammarly's site claims that organizations deploying the product save an average of $5,000 per employee per year, and references a productivity offering called Superhuman Go that pairs writing support with productivity agents.

The held facts note 161 legal exposure entries associated with California, though no specific cases are recorded in the data.
